tasks.title: Announcement #15
tasks.instruction: Listen to a teacher talking to the class.
tasks.transcript:
I'd like you to remind your parents about next week's registration.
Each family must meet with me personally to register for the 2016-2017 school year. The registration dates will be Tuesdays and Thursdays for approximately 15 minutes and each family should contact me to make an appointment before this time. So again, please let your parents know about the meeting and contact me as soon as possible.

questions.stem: What is the announcement mainly about?

options.A: The new policy of school in the 2016-2017 school year.
options.B: The registration for the new school year.
options.C: How to contact the teacher for registration.
options.D: Why students need to make an appointment.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问这段通知主要关于什么，属于主旨/话题识别题，需抓住老师整段话的核心内容。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 讲话中提到的是2016-2017学年的注册事宜，并未说明学校有任何新政策，属于无中生有。 选项B：正确。 老师明确说“Each family must meet with me personally to register for the 2016-2017 school year”，并说明了注册时间（周二和周四）和预约方式，整段话的核心内容是新生学年的注册事宜。 选项C：错误。 老师提到家长应联系她进行预约，但这只是注册过程中的一个具体步骤，并非通知的主要话题。 选项D：错误。 老师没有解释为什么需要预约，只是告知需要预约这一要求，属于偏离主旨。

questions.stem: What is probably true about the students' parents?

options.A: They are too busy to come to school.
options.B: They haven't contacted the teacher yet.
options.C: They need to bring a registration form.
options.D: They have come to the school before.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问关于学生家长很可能哪项是正确的，属于推理判断题，需根据老师讲话中的信息进行推断。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 老师要求家长来学校面谈注册，但并未说明家长太忙无法前来，属于无中生有。 选项B：正确。 老师反复强调“please let your parents know about the meeting and contact me as soon as possible”，说明家长尚未联系老师进行预约，因此需要学生转达这一信息。 选项C：错误。 讲话中没有提到需要携带注册表，属于无中生有。 选项D：错误。 讲话中没有说明家长之前是否来过学校，属于无关信息。
